_READ_THIS_INSTEAD: The ClickUp list 🤖 Agent Index (list id 901328043244) — one task per agent, both classes. Resolve per gates/agent-invocation-gate.md STEP 0.
_redirect_corrected: 2026-08-01. This field used to read 'brain-config/super-agents/roster.json' — which was ITSELF retired to a tombstone stub on 2026-07-30, five days after this file. A reader obeying both redirects landed nowhere, twice. A tombstone pointing at a tombstone is worse than no tombstone: it looks like a live trail. THE LESSON: when you retire a file, sweep the redirects AIMED at it in the same pass, including the ones inside other tombstones.
_why: This file was a BOOTSTRAP MANIFEST generated 2026-07-04, hand-authored from agents/*.md front-matter — eleven days before git-teammates existed (super-agents/ landed 2026-07-15). It could not describe the current fleet because the architecture it described predates it. roster.json was then built 2026-07-24 as the canonical combined roster of the ENTIRE fleet, which left TWO files both claiming canonical. Michael's ruling 2026-07-25: ONE documented source.
_also: By 2026-07-25 this file had grown to ~29KB and could not be read back whole by ANY path — base64 inflated it past the ~30KB blob-API cap, and the raw path served a cache-frozen ~10KB copy instead of the real blob. It was therefore unreadable, unverifiable, and unsafe to rewrite. A source of truth nobody can open is not a source of truth. Its full pre-retirement content is preserved in git history at the commit before this stub.
_the_pattern_this_file_is_evidence_of: FOUR manifests have now been retired for the same reason: registry.json (07-25), superagents.json (renamed 07-24 then retired), roster.json and roster.html (07-30). Every one of them was a table simulated by a text file that had to be read WHOLE on every lookup. The structural fix was not a smaller file, it was a LIST — a list has fields, and fields refuse essays. Do not propose a fifth.
